     and manuscript.qmd. The setup chunk below defines cross_format_table()
     which is then available to every subsequent chunk. -->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# ── Install missing packages if needed ───────────────────────────────────────
if (!requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("knitr", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("kableExtra", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# ── detect_format() ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Returns "latex", "html", or "docx" depending on the current render target.
detect_format <- function() {
  fmt <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to")
  if (is.null(fmt)) {
    return("html")
  }
  if (grepl("latex|pdf|beamer", fmt, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("latex")
  }
  if (grepl("html", fmt, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("html")
  }
  return("docx")
}

# ── cross_format_table() ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Renders a data frame as a publication-ready table in PDF, HTML, or Word.
# Captions are handled by Quarto via tbl-cap in chunk options — do NOT
# pass captions here.
#
# Arguments:
#   df        — a data frame
#   notes     — character vector of footnotes
#   align     — column alignment string (e.g. "lccc")
#   col_names — custom column headers (defaults to names(df))
#   escape    — escape special characters? (default TRUE)
#
# Usage (in any chunk with #| tbl-cap: "My Caption"):
#   cross_format_table(my_df, notes = c("A note."))
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cross_format_table <- function(df,
                               notes     = NULL,
                               align     = NULL,
                               col_names = NULL,
                               escape    = TRUE) {

  fmt    <- detect_format()
  cnames <- if (!is.null(col_names)) col_names else names(df)

  if (fmt == "latex") {
    # ── PDF / LaTeX ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Do NOT pass caption here — Quarto adds its own caption via tbl-cap
    # in the chunk options. Passing caption to kable() would create a
    # duplicate (Table 1 from Quarto + Table 2 from kable).
    tbl <- knitr::kable(
      df,
      format    = "latex",
      booktabs  = TRUE,
      escape    = escape,
      align     = align,
      col.names = cnames
    )
    tbl <- kableExtra::kable_styling(
      tbl,
      latex_options = c("HOLD_position"),
      font_size     = 11
    )
    if (!is.null(notes)) {
      tbl <- kableExtra::footnote(
        tbl,
        number            = notes,
        footnote_as_chunk = FALSE,
        escape            = FALSE
      )
    }
    return(tbl)

  } else if (fmt == "html") {
    # ── HTML ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Same: skip caption here, let Quarto handle it via tbl-cap.
    tbl <- knitr::kable(
      df,
      format    = "html",
      escape    = escape,
      col.names = cnames
    )
    tbl <- kableExtra::kable_styling(
      tbl,
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width        = FALSE,
      position          = "center"
    )
    if (!is.null(notes)) {
      tbl <- kableExtra::footnote(
        tbl,
        number            = notes,
        footnote_as_chunk = FALSE
      )
    }
    return(tbl)

  } else {
    # ── Word / docx ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Same: skip caption, Quarto handles it.
    tbl <- knitr::kable(df, col.names = cnames)
    return(tbl)
  }
}
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary Statistics"

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Age", "Income (log)", "Education (years)",
               "Employment Rate", "SES Index"),
  Mean     = c("35.20", "10.45", "13.80", "0.72", "0.00"),
  SD       = c("12.10", "1.23",  "3.20",  "0.45", "1.00"),
  Min      = c("18",    "6.21",  "0",     "0",    "-2.85"),
  Max      = c("65",    "14.50", "21",    "1",    "3.12"),
  N        = c("10,000","9,850", "10,000","10,000","9,500")
)

cross_format_table(
  summary_df,
  align     = "lccccc",
  notes     = c("Source: Your data source here.",
                "Sample restricted to ages 18-65.")
)
```


## Balance Table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-balance
#| tbl-cap: "Balance Table: Treatment vs. Control"

balance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable   = c("Age", "Female", "College Degree",
                  "Income (log)", "Married"),
  Treatment  = c("34.8", "0.51", "0.42", "10.52", "0.58"),
  Control    = c("35.1", "0.49", "0.40", "10.48", "0.56"),
  Difference = c("-0.30", "0.02", "0.02", "0.04", "0.02"),
  pvalue     = c("0.42", "0.55", "0.61", "0.38", "0.67")
)

cross_format_table(
  balance_df,
  align     = "lcccc",
  col_names = c("Variable", "Treatment", "Control", "Difference", "p-value"),
  notes     = c("Differences tested using two-sample t-tests.",
                "None are statistically significant at the 10 percent level.")
)
```

## Main Estimates

```{r}
#| label: tbl-results
#| tbl-cap: "Effect of Treatment on Outcome"

results_df <- data.frame(
  Term    = c("Treatment", "", "Age", "", "Female", "",
              "College", "", "Observations", "R-squared",
              "Year FE", "State FE"),
  Model1  = c("0.052**", "(0.024)", "", "", "", "",
              "", "", "10,000", "0.12", "No", "No"),
  Model2  = c("0.048**", "(0.023)", "0.003", "(0.002)",
              "0.015", "(0.018)", "", "",
              "10,000", "0.15", "Yes", "No"),
  Model3  = c("0.041*", "(0.022)", "0.002", "(0.002)",
              "0.012", "(0.017)", "0.089***", "(0.021)",
              "10,000", "0.21", "Yes", "Yes")
)

cross_format_table(
  results_df,
  align     = "lccc",
  col_names = c("", "(1)", "(2)", "(3)"),
  notes     = c("Standard errors in parentheses.",
                "Significance: * p < 0.10, ** p < 0.05, *** p < 0.01.",
                "All models estimated by OLS."),
  escape    = FALSE
)
```
